title: Kanithan
desc: A journalist finds himself in the crosshairs of a dreaded counterfeiting racket. Eventually, he decides to use his investigative skills to expose the racket and save his career.

title: King of Kotha
desc: Heartbroken on being back-stabbed by his childhood friend, Raju, an influential man, runs away from his hometown, Kotha. Soon, to bring back order in the town, a police officer plots a plan.

title: Nagashaurya's Aswathama
desc: A man returns to India for his sister's engagement ceremony but discovers that something terrible has happened to her. On his quest for the truth, he uncovers a series of crimes against women.

title: Thittam Irandu
desc: While her marriage preparations are underway, Inspector Athira is busy investigating the death of her friend Deepa. Later, her life turns upside down when the whole mystery unfolds before her eyes.

title: Naan Aanaiyittal
desc: Pandiyan, a gang member seeking reform, is framed for murder, forcing him to disguise himself as a wealthy man's missing son to evade danger.

title: Ruler
desc: A businesswoman adopts a stranger who saves her life and raises him as her son. However, the young man has a dark past that catches up with him despite his mother's attempts to shield him from it.

title: Saba Nayagan
desc: Arrested for public nuisance, Saba thinks of ways to get himself freed. Soon, in an attempt to coax the police, Saba narrates his love complicated story.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Tees Maar Khan
desc: Having escaped from abusive households, Tees Maar Khan and Vasudha form a familial bond. Years later, a tragedy involving the mafia leaves Tees Maar Khan vying for revenge.

title: Ramaiah Varuvarayya
desc: Nandu, a student, attends a wedding. However, things turn chaotic when the bride's father seeks protection from him, which threatens to reveal Nandu's past.

title: Yaanai Mugathaan
desc: A religious autorickshaw driver follows a morally ambiguous path in life. However, strange happenings prompt him to re-examine his conscience.

title: Good Night
desc: Mohan, an IT employee, has a perennial snoring problem. Later, when he gets married, his issue strains his marital relationship.

title: Subham
desc: The women of Bheemili are unusually transfixed by a soap opera serial. When three friends who run the cable in town decide to dig into the situation, they uncover unimaginable secrets.

title: Prince
desc: A teacher becomes smitten with his British colleague. However, their relationship is soon tested by unforeseen challenges.

title: Avan Ivan
desc: A benevolent landlord embraces two half-brothers as his chosen family, nurturing their dreams, but their lives take a perilous turn when they cross paths with a notorious cattle smuggler.

title: Sadugudu Vandi
desc: Shiva, struggling to find a decent job, finally takes up the job of a cab driver. However, things take an eerie and spooky turn when mysterious deaths start happening in the cab.
